literal: World even if desired will be achieved, time having considered with place if done.
translation: Even the whole world can be won if one acts after considering the right time and choosing the right place.
modern: தகுந்த காலத்தை அறிந்து, ஏற்ற இடத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், உலகத்தையே அடைய நினைத்தாலும் அது கைகூடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the power of combining the right time with the right place. The verb 'கருது' appears twice with slightly different senses: 'கருதினும்' means 'even if desired or intended', while 'கருதி' means 'having considered or calculated'. The word 'ஞாலம்' means the entire world, representing the highest possible ambition. 'கைகூடும்' literally means 'will join the hand', signifying successful achievement. By carefully calculating the fitting time and acting in the proper location, even the greatest of goals becomes attainable.
